Process Operator I Production Operator I Location: Arkadelphia, AR Department: Aerospace / Automotive Job Summary: Responsible for operating equipment, monitoring production area, and following safety procedures. Perform other duties as outlined by supervisor or lead person. Monitoring the quality of the products being produced. This includes inspecting the products for defects, rejecting any faulty items, and reporting issues to Quality and/or Supervisor. Requires attention to detail, technical skills, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment. No Direct Reports. Essential Duties and Responsibilities include but not limited to: •    Compliance to all safety standards, policies. Including PPE Compliance. •    Comprehend standard task procedures, work order instructions: Read, follow and initial steps through production process. •    Inspect product for any defects throughout the build process per manufacturers, and customer's specifications for process control and comprehend     system feedback to enable appropriate adjustments to        maintain quality. •    SDS - safety data sheets and site safety rules: must be adhered too. •    Enter production time into mobilist system daily. •    Set-up, operate, load, unload, and monitor process machines per set parameters and takt times. •    Identify and package product according to written work order instructions. •    Clean machines, work area and assigned zone daily. Good Housekeeping Practices (GMP). •    Perform component moves via SAP •    Assemble packaging or other shipping type components. •    Prepare paperwork and SAP moves for shipment. •    Use hand tools such as, but not limited to, battery operated smart fastener drivers and torque wrenches, dosing tubes, cleaning wands, read           calipers, scissors, knives, band saw, hot presses and               various types of material handling equipment •    Other duties as assigned: Forklift Certification. Hoist operation, floor sweeper. •    Training in Rimar Operation and sewing Dept. may be a required tasks depending on production needs. •    Learn and perform tasks with the 5 Core Values of SGL Carbon. Skills: •       Compliance with Safety Polices / Standards. •       Strong communication, planning, organizational skills. •       Decision-making and people skills. •       Strong problem solving and analytical skills. •       Ability to work independently and as a Team. •       Ability to cross train in different areas, as required. •       Ability to speak effectively before groups, other employees in process knowledge and lessons learned sharing. •       Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form and follow instructions. •       Comprehend and follow verbal instructions. Education and/or Experience: •    High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or one-year related experience. Equivalent combination of education and experience may be     accepted. •    Operational knowledge and experience using robotic or other advanced mechanical processes. •    Forklift Operator License and Hazardous Material Handling are a plus Certificates, Licenses, Registrations: •    Able to be medically certified to wear a respirator. (Respirator fit test). Physical Demands: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. •    While performing the duties of this job, an employee is regularly required to use hands/fingers to handle, feel and reach.  An employee is     required to walk, sit, climb and balance. •    The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.  Frequently lift/move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift/move up to 100 pounds. •    Specific vision abilities required include close and distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust     focus. Work Environment: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. •    While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts and fumes or airborne particles. •    The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; toxic or caustic chemicals; outside weather conditions; risk of electrical shock; and vibration.  The noise          level in the work environment is usually moderate. •    While on duty, Protective Equipment provided for this position must be used. Safety Responsibilities: With any manufacturing process, the safety of all employees should be a top priority. As a production operator, you play a critical role in ensuring that all safety protocols are followed. This includes participating in regular safety training sessions and being aware of all safety hazards that could arise during the production process. You must also ensure that all employees adhere to safety regulations, including the proper use of equipment and protective clothing. Regular monitoring and inspection of the production floor will ensure that all safety protocols are followed and reduce the likelihood of workplace injuries.
